description: Multi-channel deep search for the agent: deep_search fans queries out to web, Exa, Tavily, GitHub, MolaSearch and any MCP search server, merges by reciprocal-rank fusion with rate-limit back-off and caching; deep_verify checks cited pages lexically. Can also register as the ctx.web search provider.
descriptionZh: 为 Agent 提供多渠道深度搜索：deep_search 并行查询 web、Exa、Tavily、GitHub、MolaSearch 及任意 MCP 搜索服务，按倒数排名融合，带限速退避与缓存；deep_verify 对引用页面做词法核验。也可注册为 ctx.web 搜索提供方。
